permissions.title: Answer with contributors' computers?
permissions.what: To answer, this conversation is sent to contributors' computers on this network: your message, earlier messages in the thread, and the context prompt when it is on.
permissions.who: The first computer receives the text. The other computers receive the same content as model tokens, which read back as text, plus intermediate results.
permissions.scope: You are asked once. Later questions and follow-ups are sent the same way until you turn this off in Settings.
